point: Real condition: if + present, will in the main clause.
真實的未來條件：if + 現在式，主句 will。
why: The main clause says will resume, so this is a real condition and the if clause takes the present. The subject is the singular shipment: reaches.
主句是 will resume，這是真實條件，if 子句用現在式。主詞是單數的 shipment，所以用 reaches。

gloss.ex: We ordered a replacement valve for the pump.
The second shift starts at two.
Work will resume after the inspection.

point: unless = if … not. Check the logic.
unless = if … not，先看邏輯。
why: The hotel holds the rooms until the end of February and then releases them. They are released only if the booking is not confirmed, so the word is unless.
旅館保留房間到月底再釋出，只有在尚未確認時才會釋出，所以用 unless。

gloss.ex: The agency reserved a block of rooms for guests.
The delegation arrives on Monday.
We will release unclaimed seats on Friday.
Please confirm the booking in writing.

point: provided that = on the condition that.
provided that = 只要（附帶條件）。
why: The end of the sentence says she loses both if she waits. So transferring is the condition for keeping them: provided that. Unless would reverse the logic.
句尾說拖延就失去，所以轉調是保留的條件，用 provided that。unless 會讓邏輯顛倒。

gloss.ex: Her seniority gives her first choice of shifts.
Staff keep their pension entitlements after a transfer.
The restructuring will affect three departments.
Late applicants forfeit their deposit.

point: unless + affirmative present verb.
unless 後面用肯定的現在式。
why: Unless already means if … not, so the verb stays affirmative. A condition about the future takes the present, not will: stops.
unless 已含「如果不」，動詞用肯定式；未來的條件用現在式而非 will，所以是 stops。

gloss.ex: The launch event drew a large crowd.
The ferry service runs every hour.
Snow is forecast for Thursday.

point: Unreal present: if + past (were), would + base.
與現在事實相反：if + 過去式（were），would + 原形。
why: would be cleared and the council will not fund show the idea is not real, so the if clause takes the past. Be becomes were: were able.
would be cleared 和 the council will not fund 顯示這不是事實，if 子句用過去式，be 動詞用 were。

gloss.ex: The municipal library opens at nine.
We have a backlog of orders.
The second shift ends at midnight.
The city will fund the repairs.

point: Unreal present: main clause would + base verb.
與現在事實相反：主句 would + 原形。
why: The if clause comes last and uses the past, had. At present only the fraud team can open it, so the idea is unreal. The main clause takes would resolve.
if 子句在句尾，用過去式 had；at present only the fraud team can open 說明現況不是這樣，所以主句用 would resolve。

gloss.ex: Most queries are answered by email.
The verification step takes two minutes.
The fraud team reviews every flagged payment.

point: Unreal past: if + had + p.p.
與過去事實相反：if + had + p.p.
why: would have been avoided and in July make this an unreal past. The if clause needs the past perfect: had identified.
would have been avoided 和 in July 顯示這是與過去事實相反的假設，if 子句用過去完成式 had identified。

gloss.ex: The operations center tracks every flight.
A crew shortage delayed the morning flights.
The roster is posted every Friday.
Stranded passengers were given hotel rooms.

point: Mixed conditional: past condition, present result.
混合條件句：過去的條件，現在的結果。
why: had accepted … in 2019 is a past condition, but the result is now, seven years later. So the main clause is would be, not would have been.
had accepted … in 2019 是過去的條件，但結果在 now, seven years later，所以主句用 would be。

gloss.ex: We digitized the old records last year.
The archive holds letters from 1950.
The reading room closes at six.
The union urged the board to reconsider.

point: Mixed conditional: present condition, past result.
混合條件句：現在的條件，過去的結果。
why: were not so dependent describes the present. But the result is the disruption by the strike that ended last Monday, which already happened: would not have been.
were not so dependent 說的是現在，但結果是上週一結束的罷工造成的，已經發生，所以用 would not have been。

gloss.ex: The firm is dependent on one client.
The carrier collects parcels at noon.
Snow disrupted the delivery schedule.

point: But for + noun = if it had not been for.
But for + 名詞 = 如果沒有。
why: would have been forced is an unreal past result. The blank must mean "if there had been no loan": But for + noun. A conjunction cannot follow a bare noun phrase.
would have been forced 是過去相反的結果，空格要表示「如果沒有這筆貸款」：But for + 名詞。

gloss.ex: The emergency loan covered the payroll.
The mill employs two hundred people.
The firm had to lay off staff.

point: Without + noun = if it were not for.
Without + 名詞 = 如果沒有。
why: Without the forty volunteers means "if there were no volunteers". As it does at present shows the result is about now, so the main clause is would not be.
Without … volunteers 等於「如果沒有志工」。as it does at present 說明結果在現在，所以用 would not be。

gloss.ex: Volunteers sort the donated books.
Two clerks staff the front desk.
Ask at the information desk.
The galleries are closed on Mondays.

point: Should + subject + base verb = if … should.
Should + 主詞 + 原形 = 萬一。
why: The subject generator is singular, but the verb is fail, without -s. Only the inverted Should … fail (= if … should fail) explains a base verb here.
主詞 generator 是單數，動詞卻是沒有 -s 的 fail。只有倒裝的 Should … fail 能解釋原形。

gloss.ex: The backup generator starts within seconds.
The data center runs day and night.
The cooling system needs yearly servicing.
Hosted services stayed online during the test.

point: Were + subject + adjective = if … were.
Were + 主詞 + 形容詞：if … were 的倒裝。
why: After the long subject, only not due to expire follows: no verb. The missing word is were. Were the lease not due means If the lease were not due.
長主詞之後只有 not due to expire，沒有動詞，缺的是 were。Were the lease not due 等於 If the lease were not due。

gloss.ex: The lease runs for five years.
The premises are open to the public.
The permit expires in May.
The firm is relocating to the coast.

point: Inverted Had + subject + past participle.
Had + 主詞 + p.p.（倒裝）。
why: The opening Had stands for If … had. After the long subject, the verb must be a past participle: received. would have been unnecessary is the unreal past result.
句首 Had 代表 If … had，長主詞之後要接過去分詞 received。would have been unnecessary 是過去相反的結果。

gloss.ex: The production editor checks every layout.
Please proofread the letter before sending.
The author approved the page proofs.
An errata slip was tucked into each copy.

point: If the clause already has had, use If.
子句裡已有 had：用 If，不倒裝。
why: Inversion moves had to the front. Here had approved still sits after the subject, so nothing was moved: the opener is If.
倒裝是把 had 移到句首；這裡 had approved 還在主詞後面，沒有移動，所以用 If。

gloss.ex: The planning tribunal hears objections in May.
The developers submitted new plans.
The permit was issued in June.
The appeal was heard in March.

point: If only + past: a wish about the present.
If only + 過去式：與現在相反的願望。
why: If only expresses a wish, and the verb steps back one tense: had. would not have to queue and every morning show the real situation is different.
If only 表示願望，動詞退一格用 had。would not have to queue 和 every morning 說明現況不是這樣。

gloss.ex: The loading area is behind the hall.
Exhibitors set up their stands on Friday.
Visitors queue at the main gate.

point: It is high time + subject + past.
It is (high) time + 主詞 + 過去式。
why: It is high time that means "it should have been done already". The verb after the subject takes the past: reviewed. The long whose … phrase hides this clue.
It is high time that 表示「早該做了」，主詞後的動詞用過去式 reviewed。長長的 whose 片語把線索藏遠了。

gloss.ex: The admissions office opens at eight.
The acceptance rate fell last year.
It rained for five consecutive days.
The panel assesses each application.

point: as though + were: an untrue picture.
as though + were：與事實不符的說法。
why: although tickets will be sold to the general public shows the evening is not private. As though introduces an untrue picture, and be takes were.
although tickets will be sold to the general public 說明晚宴不是私人活動。as though 引出不符事實的描述，be 用 were。

gloss.ex: The gala dinner raised funds for the museum.
The notice was carefully worded.
The hall is booked for a private function.
Our sponsors paid for the printing.
